reason: The array is coated in grit, so brushing it clean seems like a useful first step toward restoring power.
expectation: I expect to clear the solar panels so they can collect sunlight more effectively, though the station may still need a separate restart.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but restoring solar power seems useful first.

effect: Brushing the array restored the solar supply; it still needs to be connected through the restart controls.
reaction: The result was straightforward, though I would have liked a little more detail about the restored array.
reason: The restored solar supply seems useful to reconnect before restarting the water line.
expectation: I expect the controls to restore station power from the array, though other services may still need separate restarts.

alternatives.reason: The drained water line also needs restarting, but I expect it to need power first.

effect: The solar restart brought the return plant back online, but it must replace propellant lost during the shutdown over the coming weeks.
reaction: The lost propellant was an unexpected consequence of the storm, and the restart checks made the recovery feel concrete.
reason: The drained water line is the only available gameplay action and needs to be restored as part of restarting essential services.
expectation: I expect the controls to prepare the line for water and restore flow, possibly after heating and checks.

effect: The restart controls heated and checked the outdoor line before priming it and reopening the well inlet, restoring water to the cabin tap and completing the chapter.
reaction: The sequence was satisfying because it explained how the drained line became safe to use again.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the water line was most worthwhile: the heating, checks and priming made the recovery understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Brushing the solar array was straightforward, but its result offered little detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away during the shutdown and would take weeks to replace.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to restoring power or water.

continue.text: I would continue to see whether the specimens reach Earth and what the lab learns, though this chapter's restart itself was fairly straightforward.
